scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --workspace @goease/client" "npm run dev --workspace @goease/server"
scripts.dev:foundation: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names web,health "npm run dev --workspace @goease/client-v2" "tsx scripts/foundation-health.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run build --workspace @goease/server && npm run build --workspace @goease/client && npm run build --workspace @goease/client-v2
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run test --workspace @goease/server
scripts.test:catalog-browser: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && playwright test --config tests/catalog.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run test:integration --workspace @goease/server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run db:seed --workspace @goease/server
scripts.test:price-editor: npm run build --workspace @goease/media && npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && playwright test --config tests/visit-editor.playwright.config.ts
